2021-cloze-1.explain: 主语 It 指 fluid intelligence。后半句说“保持平稳，然后开始下降”，所以空缺处应是下降之前的最高点。peak 作动词表示“达到顶峰”，与 levels out, decline 构成完整的时间线。
2021-cloze-1.trap: fades 也有“衰退”之意，但会与后面的 decline 语义重复，而且顺序不对。

2021-cloze-2.explain: 这里修饰 starts to decline，说的是一个普遍规律：流体智力通常随着年龄增长而下降。generally 表示“通常、大体上”，符合科研结论的概括语气。
2021-cloze-2.trap: 不要因为句中有 and then 就误选表示“替代”的 alternatively；这里不是二选一。

2021-cloze-3.explain: 前半句“衰老不可避免”与后半句“某些大脑变化也许并非不可避免”构成让步转折。while 在此相当于 although，引导让步状语从句。
2021-cloze-3.trap: since 表原因时逻辑也通，但语义会变成“既然衰老不可避免，所以科学家发现……”，与后文“may not be”形成的对比不如 while 精确。

2021-cloze-4.explain: 与 muscle loss 并列的是“腹部周围脂肪的____”。accumulation of body fat 是固定搭配，表示脂肪的堆积；后文 excess abdominal fat 也在复现这一含义。
2021-cloze-4.trap: consumption 是“消耗”，与脂肪堆积导致健康风险的语境相反。

2021-cloze-5.explain: This suggests the ____ that... 中的 that 从句解释前面内容，表示研究“提示了一种可能性”：生活方式因素也许能预防或延缓衰退。suggest the possibility that 是常见搭配。
2021-cloze-5.trap: decision/goal/requirement 都太确定；原文用的是 might，语气是推测。

2021-cloze-6.explain: prevent or ____ this type of decline：与 prevent（防止）并列，delay（延缓）最自然。整句意思是“防止或延缓这类衰退”。
2021-cloze-6.trap: ensure 后不能直接接 decline 表示“确保衰退”；seek 和 utilize 与 decline 搭配不通。

2021-cloze-7.explain: data that ____ measurements... 是定语从句，说明这份数据“包含”瘦肌肉和腹部脂肪的测量值。include 表示整体包含部分，符合 data 与 measurements 的关系。
2021-cloze-7.trap: supported 需要“数据支持测量”这种不合逻辑的关系；predicted 时态和语义都不对。

2021-cloze-8.explain: compared that data to reported changes 是固定搭配 compare A to B，表示“把 A 与 B 比较”。研究人员要把脂肪、肌肉数据与认知变化对照起来。
2021-cloze-8.trap: apply...to... 是“把……应用于”，不能表示“与……比较”。

2021-cloze-9.explain: people ____ higher measures of abdominal fat 是“腹部脂肪指标较高的人”。with 表示“具有、带有”，修饰 people。
2021-cloze-9.trap: above 是方位介词，不能直接说 people above higher measures。

2021-cloze-10.explain: scored worse on measures of fluid intelligence 表示“在流体智力测试中得分更差”。score 与 on a test/measure 搭配，是测试语境的常用动词。
2021-cloze-10.trap: live/manage/play 都不能与 worse on measures 构成“得分更差”的意思。

2021-cloze-11.explain: as the years ____ 表示“随着岁月流逝”。go by 是“（时间）过去、流逝”的固定表达。
2021-cloze-11.trap: run out 是“用完”，主语通常是物；set off 是“出发”，drew in 是“吸引/驶入”。

2021-cloze-12.explain: be attributable to 表示“可归因于”。女性身上的关联可能源于腹部脂肪过多造成的免疫变化；后文用分号对比男性，说明这是在解释原因。
2021-cloze-12.trap: superior to 是“优于”，parallel to 是“与……平行”，resistant to 是“抵抗”，都不能解释 association 的来源。

2021-cloze-13.explain: the immune system did not appear to be involved 表示“免疫系统似乎没有参与其中”。be involved in 是“参与、与……有关”，与上句女性免疫变化形成对照。
2021-cloze-13.trap: isolated 是“被隔离”，restored 是“被恢复”，controlled 是“被控制”，都不符合“是否参与”的对比。

2021-cloze-14.explain: future studies could ____ these differences：未来研究要“解释”这些性别差异。explain 与 differences 搭配自然，也符合科研目的。
2021-cloze-14.trap: alter/remove differences 是“改变/消除差异”，语义过强；spread differences 搭配不成立。

2021-cloze-15.explain: lead to different ____ for men and women：既然发现了男女机制不同，就可能带来不同的“治疗方法”。treatment for... 是固定搭配。
2021-cloze-15.trap: symptoms 是“症状”，不是研究带来的结果；compensations/demands 与医疗语境不符。

2021-cloze-16.explain: 前面讲研究机制，这里转到“与此同时，你也能采取一些措施”，从科学发现过渡到生活建议。meanwhile 表示话题的并行推进。
2021-cloze-16.trap: therefore 会变成“因此你可以采取措施”，但前后不是严格因果；instead 表示替代，逻辑不符。

2021-cloze-17.explain: take steps to do sth 是固定搭配，表示“采取措施做某事”。steps 与 take 构成动宾关系。
2021-cloze-17.trap: change steps 是“改变步骤”，watch/count steps 是“看/数步骤”，都不符合“采取措施”的意思。

2021-cloze-18.explain: protect both your physical and mental ____：与 physical and mental 搭配的是 well-being，表示“身心健康”。
2021-cloze-18.trap: physical and mental process 是“身心过程”，formation/coordination 也不能与“保护”构成自然搭配。

2021-cloze-19.explain: your ____ of aerobic exercise：level of exercise 表示“运动量/运动水平”。后文 maintaining or increasing 也提示这是一个可以“保持或增加”的量。
2021-cloze-19.trap: love/knowledge/space 都不能与 increase 搭配表示“增加运动量”。

2021-cloze-20.explain: Mediterranean-style ____ that is high in fiber and eliminates highly processed foods：“富含纤维、排除高度加工食品”显然是在描述饮食，diet 最准确。
2021-cloze-20.trap: routine 可以指“日常习惯”，但 high in fiber 是描述食物的，diet 更具体。

2021-text1-21.explain:
正确项：remains an unreasonable measure. 原文首句以强烈反问提出质疑：“How can the train operators possibly justify yet another increase to rail passenger fares?”，明示再次涨价毫无正当性与合理性；且本年度平均涨幅达 2.7%，仍明显高于官方 CPI 衡量的通胀率。因此，作者认为今年的票价上涨仍然是一项不合理的举措。
其他选项：A. has kept pace with inflation.：与原文相反。今年涨幅平均为 2.7%，明显高于 CPI 衡量的通胀率，并未与通胀同步。；B. is a big surprise to commuters.：与原文不符。每年一月涨价已成为令人沮丧却准时上演的年度惯例（grimly reliable annual ritual），乘客早有预期，并非意外。；D. will ease train operators' burden.：因果与主体倒置。涨价加重的是乘客的经济负担（imposing a significant extra burden on those who...）；作者通篇都在批判服务质量低劣、罢工频发背景下持续涨价的不合理性，并未把“缓解运营商负担”作为合理性论据。
2021-text1-21.evidence:
How can the train operators possibly justify yet another increase to rail passenger fares?
This year's rise, an average of 2.7 per cent, may be a fraction lower than last year's, but it is still well above the official Consumer Price Index (CPI) measure of inflation.

2021-text1-22.explain:
正确项：rail travelers. 句中的 stockbroker 是一个使用铁路通勤的个人例子，用来代表使用铁路网络、应当承担成本的乘客。 反问句将其与开车的林肯郡退休者对比，强调这类铁路乘客不应由纳税人补贴。
其他选项：A. car drivers.：张冠李戴。开车的人是 Lincolnshire 的退休者，并非 stockbroker 所代表的群体。；C. local investors.：无中生有。stockbroker 是职业身份，文中没有谈地方投资者。；D. ordinary taxpayers.：主体错位。普通纳税人是不应承担铁路成本的对立方，而不是 stockbroker 的指代对象。
2021-text1-22.evidence:
Successive governments have permitted such increases on the grounds that the cost of investing in and running the rail network should be borne by those who use it, rather than the general taxpayer.
Why, the argument goes, should a car-driving pensioner from Lincolnshire have to subsidise the daily commute of a stockbroker from Surrey?

2021-text1-23.explain:
正确项：have failed to provide an adequate service. 运营商虽宣传网络改善，但作者指出乘客至少应得到基本服务，而近年罢工使乘客遭受严重出行中断。 这表明实际服务水平没有达到乘客支付的价格应当对应的基本标准。
其他选项：A. are offering compensation to commuters.：主体和时态错位。文中是说受影响乘客应获补偿，不是运营商已经提供补偿。；B. are trying to repair relations with the unions.：无中生有。文章反而说罢工责任在工会，没有提到修复双方关系。；D. have suffered huge losses owing to the strikes.：无中生有。文中强调乘客遭受的服务中断，没有说运营商遭受巨额损失。
2021-text1-23.evidence:
It is all very well train operators trumpeting the improvements they are making to the network, but passengers should be able to expect a basic level of service for the substantial sums they are now paying to travel.
However, there is a strong case that those who have been worst affected by industrial action should receive compensation for the disruption they have suffered.

2021-text1-24.explain:
正确项：a change of ownership. 末段警告，若乘客的正当愤怒不能迅速得到处理，暂时退去的铁路国有化威胁将猛烈卷土重来。 nationalisation 意味着铁路从私营转为国家所有，因而就是所有权发生变化。
其他选项：A. the loss of investment.：无中生有。文章说铁路需要更多投资，未预测安抚失败将导致投资流失。；B. the collapse of operations.：过度推断。原文警告国有化威胁回归，不等于铁路运营将崩溃。；C. a reduction of revenue.：无中生有。本句谈的是国有化风险，没有说收入会减少。
2021-text1-24.evidence: The threat of nationalisation may have been seen off for now, but it will return with a vengeance if the justified anger of passengers is not addressed in short order.

2021-text1-25.explain:
正确项：Ever-rising Fares Aren't Sustainable 全文从票价年年上涨且高于通胀切入，继而指出乘客付出高昂费用却忍受罢工、拥挤和混乱。 作者最终明言乘客不会无限期支付更高票价，因而“不断上涨的票价难以持续”概括了主旨。
其他选项：A. Who Are to Blame for the Strikes?：范围过窄。罢工只是服务不足的一个表现，全文核心是票价上涨与服务不匹配。；B. Constant Complaining Doesn't Work：主体错位且无中生有。文章要求回应乘客的正当愤怒，并非批评乘客抱怨无效。；C. Can Nationalisation Bring Hope?：主题偏移。国有化仅在结尾作为运营商不回应乘客时的风险，文章没有讨论它能否带来希望。
2021-text1-25.evidence:
How can the train operators possibly justify yet another increase to rail passenger fares?
Yes, more investment is needed, but passengers will not be willing to pay more indefinitely if they must also endure cramped, unreliable services, punctuated by regular chaos when timetables are changed, or planned maintenance is managed incompetently.
The threat of nationalisation may have been seen off for now, but it will return with a vengeance if the justified anger of passengers is not addressed in short order.

2021-text2-26.explain:
正确项：help poor families get better off. CCT 在符合上学、就医等条件时向最贫困居民发放现金，目标是减少不平等、打破贫困循环，并已改善儿童营养。这些信息共同指向帮助贫困家庭改善生活。
其他选项：A. facilitate healthcare reform.：范围缩小。就医是领取条件之一，项目总体目标是减贫与减少不平等，不是推动医疗改革。；C. improve local education systems.：范围缩小。要求孩子留在学校是条件，文中没说改善地方教育体系。；D. lower deforestation rates.：将研究发现误作为初始目标。CCT 的设计目的是社会救助，降低伐森是后文发现的环境效果。
2021-text2-26.evidence:
In 2007, Indonesia started phasing in a program that gives money to its poorest residents under certain conditions, such as requiring people to keep kids in school or get regular medical care.
Called conditional cash transfers or CCTs, these social assistance programs are designed to reduce inequality and break the cycle of poverty.
In Indonesia, the program has provided enough food and medicine to substantially reduce severe growth problems among children.

2021-text2-27.explain:
正确项：economic growth tends to cause environmental degradation. 墨西哥的旧研究支持传统观点：人们得到更多钱后，一些人会清理更多土地养牛，因而经济改善可能伴随环境破坏。文中同时提醒“相关不等于因果”，但这不改变该研究所支持的趋势判断。
其他选项：A. cattle raising has been a major means of livelihood for the poor.：范围和重点错误。养牛是例子中的土地利用方式，不是研究要说明的主旨。；B. CCT programs have helped preserve traditional lifestyles.：与原文不符。墨西哥研究说的是获得更多钱后清理土地，并非保存传统生活。；C. antipoverty efforts require the participation of local farmers.：无中生有。文中没有讨论贫困减缓项目的参与者条件。
2021-text2-27.evidence:
That's because economic growth can be correlated with environmental degradation, while protecting the environment is sometimes correlated with greater poverty.
The only previous study analyzing causality, based on an area in Mexico that had instituted CCTs, supported the traditional view.
There, as people got more money, some of them may have more cleared land for cattle to raise for meat, Ferraro says.

2021-text2-28.explain:
正确项：the relation of CCTs to its forest loss. 研究目的在原文中直接表述为查看印尼扶贫项目是否影响伐森；因此关键是检验 CCT 与森林损失之间的关系。
其他选项：A. its acceptance level of CCTs.：无中生有。研究没有调查居民对项目的接受度。；B. its annual rate of poverty alleviation.：范围错位。文章谈的是环境效果，不是每年脱贫率。；D. the role of its forests in climate change.：无中生有。研究关注伐森变化是否与项目有关，并未讨论森林在气候变化中的作用。
2021-text2-28.evidence: Ferraro wanted to see if Indonesia's poverty-alleviation program was affecting deforestation.

2021-text2-29.explain:
正确项：it can protect the environment. 印尼 CCT 项目与伐森量减少 30% 相关，且仅减少二氧化碳排放所产生的价值就高于项目成本。 费拉罗因而强调，对人有利的项目也可能对环境有利，这是其最突出的附加价值。
其他选项：A. it will benefit other Asian countries.：把可能性说成确定结果。作者说能否推广到别处尚难确定，只是费拉罗推测或可适用于亚洲其他地区。；B. it will reduce regional inequality.：偷换概念。CCT 的一般目标包括减少不平等，但本题所问的突出价值是印尼研究发现的环境效应。；D. it can benefit grain production.：因果倒置。农民在降雨延误时开地种稻是应对风险的原有做法；CCT 提供保障后反而减少这种开地，并非提高粮食产量。
2021-text2-29.evidence:
"We see that the program is associated with a 30 percent reduction in deforestation," Ferraro says.
And regardless of transferability, the study shows that what's good for people may also be good for the environment.
Even if his program didn't reduce poverty, Ferraro says, "the value of the avoided deforestation just for carbon dioxide emissions alone is more than the program costs."

2021-text2-30.explain:
正确项：The effects of a program. 文章围绕印尼 CCT 项目展开：先说明其对贫困家庭和儿童健康的作用，再重点呈现它与伐森量下降的关联及环境价值。这些都属于一个项目产生的多方面影响。
其他选项：B. The debates over a program.：文体和主线错误。文章对比传统观点与新发现，是为了突出项目效果，并非展开争论。；C. The process of a study.：范围过窄。卫星数据和样本只是研究方法的简要交代，全文重点在结果及其意义。；D. The transferability of a study.：以偏概全。结果能否推广仅在末段讨论，且原文明言无论能否推广，研究已显示民生与环境可同时受益。
2021-text2-30.evidence:
One reason for the turnaround may be the country's antipoverty program.
In fact, poverty alleviation and environmental protection are often viewed as conflicting goals, says Paul Ferraro, an economist at Johns Hopkins University.
"We see that the program is associated with a 30 percent reduction in deforestation," Ferraro says.
And regardless of transferability, the study shows that what's good for people may also be good for the environment.

2021-text3-31.explain:
正确项：changed people's impression of the Victorians. 作者搜集微笑照片的目的正是“打破人们对 19 世纪维多利亚时代拘谨刻板的固有印象（shatter the image of 19th-century prudery）”；发布到推特后引起轰动，人们惊讶地发现维多利亚人也会享受生活、也会欢笑（surprised to see evidence that Victorians had fun and could, and did, laugh），百年时空隔阂随之消退，维多利亚人显得更具人情味。这表明作者的推特发帖改变了大众对维多利亚人的刻板印象。
其他选项：B. highlighted social media's role in Victorian studies.：偷换重点。Twitter 只是作者分享照片的社交传播途径，文章核心并未探讨社交媒体在历史学术研究中的作用。；C. re-evaluated the Victorian's notion of public image.：主客体错位。文中重新审视的是现代人对维多利亚人的历史认知，而非维多利亚人自己对公众形象的观念。；D. illustrated the development of Victorian photography.：偏离主旨。发布微笑照片是为了呈现维多利亚人富有人情味的真实一面，而非展现维多利亚时代摄影技术或摄影史的发展。
2021-text3-31.evidence:
As a historian who's always searching for the text or the image that makes us re-evaluate the past, I've become preoccupied with looking for photographs that show our Victorian ancestors smiling (what better way to shatter the image of 19th-century prudery?).
I've found quite a few, and—since I started posting them on Twitter—they have been causing quite a stir.
People have been surprised to see evidence that Victorians had fun and could, and did, laugh. They are noting that the Victorians suddenly seem to become more human as the hundred-or-so years that separate us fade away through our common experience of laughter.

2021-text3-32.explain:
正确项：They are rare among photographs of that age. 作者在第二段开篇做出让步：“my collection of 'Smiling Victorians' makes up only a tiny percentage of the vast catalogue of photographic portraiture created between 1840 and 1900...”（我收集的微笑照片只占 1840 至 1900 年间庞大肖像摄影目录中极小的一部分，绝大多数被摄者神情都僵硬痛苦）。makes up only a tiny percentage（仅占极小比例）直接同义替换为 B 项的 rare among photographs of that age（在那个时代的摄影作品中十分罕见）。
其他选项：A. They are in popular use among historians.：无中生有。作者仅提到自己作为历史学家搜集并分享了这批照片，并未提及这批照片在历史学界得到广泛普遍应用。；C. They mirror 19th-century social conventions.：与文意相反。当时的主流社会习俗是严肃拘谨、不苟言笑（大多数肖像都僵硬严肃），这批微笑照片属于极少数的罕见反例，不能代表普遍社会习俗。；D. They show effects of different exposure times.：张冠李戴。曝光时间的长短是后文用来解释为什么多数肖像表情严肃僵硬的技术背景，并非对这批微笑照片自身特征的评价。
2021-text3-32.evidence: Of course, I need to concede that my collection of 'Smiling Victorians' makes up only a tiny percentage of the vast catalogue of photographic portraiture created between 1840 and 1900, the majority of which show sitters posing miserably and stiffly in front of painted backdrops, or staring absently into the middle distance.

2021-text3-33.explain:
正确项：Their unhealthy dental condition. 第四段指出，到 19 世纪 90 年代由于快门和便携相机的发展，曝光已近乎瞬时完成，自然笑容很容易被捕捉，技术障碍已被排除，必须从别处寻找原因；第五段随即指出：露齿傻笑有失尊严，当时格言称“大自然赐予双唇是为了遮住牙齿”，暗指正规牙科诞生前“口腔卫生状况糟糕得惊人（mouths were often in a shocking state of hygiene）”，健康洁白的牙齿极度罕见。因此，不健康的牙齿状况是维多利亚人在 1890 年代拍照仍不愿微笑的核心原因。
其他选项：A. Their inherent social sensitiveness.：无中生有。文中未将不笑归结于人们天生或内在的社会敏感。；B. Their tension before the camera.：非主要原因。第四段明确说明 1890 年代自然笑容已经很容易捕捉，镜头前的单纯紧张无法解释普遍长期的不愿微笑。；C. Their distrust of new inventions.：无中生有。文中并未提及人们对新式便携相机或发明抱有怀疑或不信任。
2021-text3-33.evidence:
Spontaneous smiles were relatively easy to capture by the 1890s, so we must look elsewhere for an explanation of why Victorians still hesitated to smile.
One explanation might be the loss of dignity displayed through a cheesy grin. "Nature gave us lips to conceal our teeth," ran one popular Victorian maxim, alluding to the fact that before the birth of proper dentistry, mouths were often in a shocking state of hygiene. A flashing set of healthy and clean, regular 'pearly whites' was a rare sight in Victorian society, the preserve of the super-rich...

2021-text3-34.explain:
正确项：a deep-rooted belief. 第六段指出，维多利亚社会普遍认为露齿而笑缺乏格调、不体面；随后用强调让步句引入名人的态度：“连马克·吐温这样一个平时极爱开怀大笑的人，谈到肖像照时也认为没有什么比永久定格的傻笑更有损形象了”。引用一个平日极度爱笑的公众人物在面对正式肖像时也坚决拒斥微笑，正是为了证明“肖像照中不该微笑”是维多利亚时期一种跨越阶层、深入人心且根深蒂固的普遍社会共识与观念（a deep-rooted belief）。
其他选项：B. a misguided attitude.：褒贬不当。作者是在客观剖析维多利亚时期特定社会文化语境下形成的审美与礼貌规范，并未将该态度批判为“被误导的偏见”。；C. a controversial view.：与文意不符。文中表明这是当时社会各阶层普遍恪守的准则，连马克·吐温都深表赞同，并未体现争议或对立。；D. a thought-provoking idea.：偏离论证目的。马克·吐温的话是作为典型例证支撑论点，旨在证明该观念深入人心，而非为了提出某种发人深省的新鲜思想。
2021-text3-34.evidence:
A toothy grin (especially when there were gaps or blackened gnashers) lacked class: drunks, tramps, and music hall performers might gurn and grin with a smile as wide as Lewis Carroll's gum-exposing Cheshire Cat, but it was not a becoming look for properly bred persons.
Even Mark Twain, a man who enjoyed a hearty laugh, said that when it came to photographic portraits there could be "nothing more damning than a silly, foolish smile fixed forever".

2021-text3-35.explain:
正确项：Why did most Victorians look stern in photographs? 文章明确提出 How do we explain this trend?， 随后依次考察早期长曝光、牙齿卫生、尊严观念和阶层礼仪， 全部服务于解释多数维多利亚肖像为何神情严肃。
其他选项：B. Why did the Victorians start to view photographs?：偷换问题。；C. What made photography develop in the Victorian period?：范围扩大。；D. How did smiling in photographs become a post-Victorian norm?：时间范围错位。
2021-text3-35.evidence:
How do we explain this trend?
During the 1840s and 1850s, in the early days of photography, exposure times were notoriously long: the daguerreotype photographic method (producing an image on a silvered copper plate) could take several minutes to complete, resulting in blurred images as sitters shifted position or adjusted their limbs.
Spontaneous smiles were relatively easy to capture by the 1890s, so we must look elsewhere for an explanation of why Victorians still hesitated to smile.
One explanation might be the loss of dignity displayed through a cheesy grin.

2021-text4-36.explain:
正确项：show partiality in treating clients. 原文担忧服务商会 favor affiliated websites over their rivals'， 并利用控制权 pick winners and losers；两处都指向区别对待、偏袒关联客户。
其他选项：A. bring web-based firms under control.：范围扩大。；B. slow down the traffic on their network.：无中生有。；D. intensify competition with their rivals.：与原意相反。
2021-text4-36.evidence:
From the early days of broadband, advocates for consumers and web-based companies worried that the cable and phone companies selling broadband connections had the power and incentive to favor affiliated websites over their rivals'.
That's why there has been such a strong demand for rules that would prevent broadband providers from picking winners and losers online, preserving the freedom and innovation that have been the lifeblood of the Internet.

2021-text4-37.explain:
正确项：takes an anti-regulatory stance. FCC 的 2017 年命令取消严格的网络中立规则， 又否定自身和州、地方政府的监管权，体现了明确的反监管立场。
其他选项：A. sticks to an out-of-date order.：偷换重点。；C. has issued a special resolution.：与原文不符。；D. has allowed the states to intervene.：与原文相反。
2021-text4-37.evidence:
The Republican-penned order not only eliminated the strict net neutrality rules the FCC had adopted when it had a Democratic majority in 2015, but rejected the commission's authority to require broadband providers to do much of anything.
The order also declared that state and local governments couldn't regulate broadband providers either.

2021-text4-38.explain:
正确项：It engages in anti-competitive practices. AT&T 被作为反竞争行为的例子：它可以偏袒自家流媒体服务， 损害 Netflix 和 Apple TV 等竞争对手的利益。
其他选项：A. It protects against unfair competition.：主体错位。；C. It is under the FCC's investigation.：与原文不符。；D. It is in pursuit of quality service.：无中生有。
2021-text4-38.evidence:
The commission argued that other agencies would protect against anti-competitive behavior, such as a broadband-providing conglomerate like AT&T favoring its own video-streaming service at the expense of Netflix and Apple TV.
Yet the FCC also ended the investigations of broadband providers that imposed data caps on their rivals' streaming services but not their own.

2021-text4-39.explain:
正确项：is out of touch with reality. 米利特法官说该结果 is unhinged from the realities of modern broadband service， 即该裁决脱离现代宽带服务的现实。
其他选项：A. focus on trivialities.：无中生有。；B. conveys an ambiguous message.：偷换概念。；C. is at odds with its earlier rulings.：与原文相反。
2021-text4-39.evidence: But Judge Patricia Millett rightly argued in a concurring opinion that "the result is unhinged from the realities of modern broadband service," and said Congress or the Supreme Court could intervene to "avoid trapping Internet regulation in technological anachronism."

2021-text4-40.explain:
正确项：Congress needs to take action to ensure net neutrality. 作者明言法律争斗和 FCC 政策反复迫切需要国会行动， 并主张由国会授权 FCC 阻止宽带服务商干预网络流量，保护网络开放与创新。
其他选项：B. The FCC should be put under strict supervision.：方向错误。；C. Rules need to be set to diversify online services.：偷换目的。；D. Broadband providers' rights should be protected.：与原文相反。
2021-text4-40.evidence:
The endless legal battles and back-and-forth at the FCC cry out for Congress to act.
It needs to give the commission explicit authority once and for all to bar broadband providers from meddling in the traffic on their network and to create clear rules protecting openness and innovation online.
